steers.detail: 3 long positions. One BTC dump hits all of them.

deep_analysis:

1. SOL #16604 (jup_yolo, meta_rsi 71.4) — weakest. Top-of-band entry on a NEUTRAL/ranging 15m tape (r2 0.016, 0.00%/16c). The 60+ jup_yolo cell is 3T 1W -$0.38 with 2 of 3 losers never armed. Would not open fresh.
   STEER 🔴 [stale/chop, age=1 cycle unexecuted]: Exit SOL #16604 when trade age reaches 4h (~08:35Z) if unrealized MFE is still <+0.40% — re-read this cycle: still open, price 95.78 < entry 95.909, live mfe NULL (DB stamps only at close) so the unarmed premise stands. Do not restate if the trade closes or MFE reaches +0.40% first.

2. HYPE #16606 (jup_yolo, meta_rsi 30.5, vol HIGH, opened 07:11Z) — entry band is the measured-good cell (<45: 14T 11W 78.6% +$0.42 re-run this cycle), SL 87.21 (-1.07%) / TP 89.91 (+2.0%) both set. Caveat: HYPE 15m is NEUTRAL/ranging and the last oversold HYPE long (meta_rsi 11.8, #16602) lost -0.21 never armed — the band wins on average, individuals still die in chop. No action: let SL/TP own it. SUPERSEDED: prior-cycle steer on #16605 (exit-if-below-88.08 while HYPE 15m negative) — trade closed +0.07 (win) at ~07:12Z, dropped from actionable list.

3. BTC #16599 (continuum-osc+, meta_rsi 45.2 mid-band) — most defensible. Condition re-read at 07:18Z: BTC 1m has held ABOVE continuum EMA300 for 53m straight (77445 vs ~77304-77345 depending on source), btc_15m + btc_4h LONG_BIAS, signal family 3/3 +$0.15.
   STEER 🟡 [regime, age=1 cycle unexecuted]: Keep BTC long while 1m closes hold above continuum EMA300 (recompute at execute: ~77345 from regime feed / ~77304 from 1m EMA calc); if 1m closes fall below EMA300 for 60m+ with 15m linreg turning negative, the osc-long thesis is gone — exit rather than wait for SL 76993. Condition currently HOLDS (above, 53m).

Would I open fresh today: SOL no (top of band, ranging coin). HYPE yes (only measured-profitable jup_yolo cell). BTC yes while EMA300 holds. IMX yes — picked below.

Portfolio: 3/3 long = maxed correlation. One BTC dump through 76993 hits all three. Direction call itself is fine (aggregate LONG_BIAS 75L/6S), but there is no hedge and no shorts on a tape where auto_trader scores long 35 / short -15 and calls CHOP.

AI trader: PICK (watchlist only — AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False since 2026-10-19, will NOT execute): IMX LONG conf 72 @ 0.1234, rsi_at_pick 59.0. Precheck PASS all gates (ATR 1.57%, RR 0.75 grade D passes, RSI 59.0 outside the 45-55 death zone, price 2min fresh, coin4h LONG_BIAS conf 87.2). Slots: 3/6 open, last pick 06:19Z (58min, outside 45min window), no rejected_at. Also-tested-and-rejected this cycle: TIA (no price data), ENA (RR 0.40 hard block + stale + death zone), USELESS (BTC LONG gate), ONDO/CRV PASS but both sit in the 45-55 death zone advisory — skipped in favour of IMX.
regime_context:
Quote source with every claim — sources disagree. regime_5m 07:00Z aggregate = LONG_BIAS (75L/6S/48N); regimes.BTC = NEUTRAL (ranging, r2 0.397); btc_15m + btc_4h = LONG_BIAS; continuum = AT EMA300 (duration ~48m, price crossed above ~06:20Z and has held); auto_trader regime = CHOP (score long 35 / short -15, MANAGE_ONLY); zscore STRONG_POS, velocity SLOW, volume NORMAL, wyckoff MARKUP / trend_quality STRONG_UP vs market_phase DECLINING (different fields, not a contradiction). Volatility NORMAL.

Flip rate last 24h (re-run): aggregate 19 flips, BTC 15m 24 flips — p50 baseline is ~19-20 and p95 is 26, so BOTH are routine standing churn, not an anomaly (the old >=6 line is vestigial). Average direction state survives ~1h. Consequence: no snapshot-directional advice — every steer above is condition-keyed and re-tested next cycle. The genuinely informative state would be <6 flips (real trend tape), which has not occurred since Oct 2.

Trade-regime verdict: LONGs are on the correct side of the aggregate tape and BTC 1m has been above EMA300 for 53m. But the tape is churn, not trend — auto_trader CHOP + AT EMA300 + 19-24 flips means entries are more likely to stall than run. That is consistent with the chop-bleed KPI below: we are entering in chop and never arming.
